summary: Mid-block corner commercial building with frontage on north main street and east side street; likely main entry on north facade, possible side entry east and service access from south alley. Stage on street curb lanes; watch street trees and alley parked vehicles.
notes: Entrances are inferred from overhead signs (canopies, walkways, recesses), snapped to the building outline. Confirm against the interior scan before relying on one.
Pixel coordinates are [x, y] in the image at tile_path, origin top-left, north up.
The yellow outline is the ground footprint. Roofs of taller buildings appear shifted a few metres from it because the overhead image is not perfectly vertical.

events.summary: No disaster effects are visible around the outlined building in the 2025-02-02 image. The roof appears intact with no burn scars, the adjacent streets and alley are open with normal traffic and parked cars, and there is no standing water or debris on the approaches. The building's footprint looks somewhat different between the captures, but this is consistent with viewing angle or registration offset rather than damage. The blue tarp on the roof of the building to the south (around x 58-72, y 75-80) is also present in the recent image, so it is not attributable to the fire. An emergency crew would have had an unobstructed approach.

disaster.note: Coverage means a post-event flight imaged this ground. It does not mean the building was damaged; see each event's findings.
